architectural_notes: Daily report should display one row per day (only days with data) for a selected date range, and include a summary row for the entire period; behavior should match prior working version (including scrolling/visibility).
known_issues: Bug/regression: Daily report only shows the first day/one record after import (e.g., 1 of 134 records reflected); report list appears not scrollable so remaining days are not visible.

existing_features.title: Fix the Daily Report so it reliably returns and displays one aggregated record per calendar day (within the selected date range) for days that have pickups, and it does not collapse multiple days into a single displayed day.

Ensure the Daily Report dialog supports scrolling so all daily breakdown cards and the final summary are reachable on both desktop and mobile (including the reported case where it appears 'not scrollable').
Keep (or restore) the end-of-period summary section for the selected date range, and ensure its totals match the sum of the displayed daily breakdown totals for the period.
Add/extend a manual regression check document entry specifically for this issue: multi-day daily report after import should show all days with data and be scrollable.

projectName: Fix Daily Report regression: show one record per day with data + working scrolling + period summary
